items.title: Mirror NinjaTrader intent ownership doctrine in profile handoff
acceptance: Profile worker treats duplicate intent UUID retries as gateway-owned replay, not new decisions.
Profile docs forbid time-based resubmission or hidden deterministic gates.
SOUL and AUTHORITY describe truthful evidence-only cognition aligned with gateway receipts.
evidence: 2026-07-25 commits d9a1ab0, a828e1f, ab0f480: truthful Topstep evidence, native MTF, rolling tape and partial depth doctrine.
2026-07-27: gateway atomic UUID+body claim and conflict receipts (glitch-topstep); profile AUTHORITY cross-ref updated.
PR #16 merged: discard_stale_outbox_intent only on stored_packet_not_found.

items.title: Compact frame snapshots for LLM prompts
acceptance: decision_packet stays full; recent_frames use glitch.topstep.frame_snapshot.v2.
GLITCH_TOPSTEP_DECISION_FRAME_COUNT configures frame window (default 5).
Tests cover packet_model and prompt envelope shape.
evidence: PR #17 merged: scripts/packet_model.py, run-topstep-cycle integration, 61 tests passing.

items.title: Align ARCHITECTURE with flat frame warmup gate
acceptance: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and AUTHORITY.md state whether flat cycles require N frames before first LLM call.
Either document GLITCH_TOPSTEP_DECISION_FRAME_COUNT as scheduling warmup, or remove silent flat gate and invoke with available frames.
evidence: 2026-07-30 decision: keep flat warmup at GLITCH_TOPSTEP_DECISION_FRAME_COUNT (default 5).
2026-07-30: ARCHITECTURE.md and AUTHORITY.md document flat scheduling warmup vs positioned immediate invoke.
2026-07-30 audit: run-topstep-cycle returns 0 when len(frames) < decision_frame_count() while flat.

items.title: Consolidate minute-frame lookup helpers
acceptance: Single helper for packet_id -> stored frame/packet used by cycle and learning workers.
No semantic change to debrief_evidence or outbox validation.

items.title: Bind work to glitch-topstep gateway ledger
acceptance: Cross-repository gateway/profile beta work has a named dependency and separate acceptance authority.
evidence: Gateway issue #52 and PR #53 replace the incorrect dependency on RAIL-006 with PROFILE-BETA-01.

items.title: Separate local wake-trigger validation from gateway wire delivery
acceptance: A decision with explicit price conditions is validated with its wake triggers before local-only fields are removed.
The gateway wire payload omits wake_triggers without reapplying local scheduler validation to the stripped payload.
A pending outbox with valid wake triggers reaches delivery and cannot starve all later cognition.
Detached operator-worker failures are visible through profile status rather than masked by a successful launcher.
evidence: 2026-07-31 live incident: valid NOTHING decisions at 06:05, 09:06, and 12:11 UTC remained in outbox because prepare_intent_for_delivery removed wake_triggers before validate_intent required them.
2026-07-31 deterministic reproduction: explicit above/below change_condition with matching triggers raised wake_triggers_missing_for_change_condition only during delivery projection.
2026-07-31 fix: validate the complete local decision before projecting glitch.intent.v2, persist direct-worker-status.json, and expose that status through /topstep_status.
2026-07-31 regression suite: explicit trigger parity, missing trigger rejection, real pending-outbox delivery path, and detached-worker status visibility.

items.title: Prove the immutable Topstep Hermes profile against the paired gateway beta artifact
acceptance: One immutable profile manifest is paired with one immutable gateway artifact.
Install/update, cron reconciliation, status, cognition, outbox delivery, restart continuity, and gateway receipts pass on the target Windows machine.
Quiet tape, volatility, spread, session, confidence, and learning observations remain evidence for Hermes rather than hidden action gates.
The operator explicitly promotes the named artifact pair.
items.blocked_reason: Requires the target Windows/Hermes installation, ProjectX credentials, the paired gateway artifact, and an operator-approved PRACTICE/shadow acceptance session.
items.stop_line: No beta-ready or unattended evaluation/live claim until the paired artifacts and operator promotion are recorded.
